item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 14 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #LanaoDelSur(Bumbaran), #Bukidnon(Lantapan, CityOfValencia), #DavaoDeOro(NewBataan, Compostela) and #DavaoOriental(Baganga) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #LanaoDelSur(Maguing, LumbaBayabao, Bubong), #Bukidnon(Talakag), #MisamisOriental(Claveria) and #AgusanDelSur(Esperanza) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
